name: How long does a typical basement remodeling project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical basement remodeling project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a basement remodel depends largely on the square footage, layout complexity, and mechanical additions. A standard unfinished basement finish typically takes 6 to 12 weeks once construction begins. Timelines expand if your design includes complex underground plumbing rough-ins for a new bathroom or kitchenette, custom finish carpentry, or framing around low-hanging ductwork and support beams. As an owner-operated team, we coordinate carpentry, drywall, tile, and painting directly with licensed plumbing and electrical sub-trades to keep phases moving smoothly and avoid scheduling gaps.
acceptedAnswer.description: A basement remodel usually takes 6 to 12 weeks, depending on square footage, bathroom rough-ins, and layout complexity.
